title: The Sky Bridge
prompt:
Black-and-white line art coloring book page with clean, medium-weight outlines and no shading, gray, gradients, or filled black areas. Full-page vertical composition featuring Elliott (4–5 years old, short straight light-brown hair, big gray-blue eyes, round cheeks, friendly adventurous expression, wearing medieval tunic with belt and boots or casual explorer outfit), Colette (2–3 years old, wavy brown hair in a top knot, large gray-blue eyes, soft cheeks, wearing whimsical princess-meets-adventurer dress with floral or heart motifs), and Winnie (tan Chihuahua–Pug mix with upright ears and curled tail, small size) walking across a floating stone bridge in the sky. Elliott, Colette, and Winnie fill most of the lower two-thirds of the page. Above them coils a long, elegant, wingless cloud-serpent dragon with whiskers and flowing mane extending upward toward the top edge to avoid blank sky. Puffy clouds and curved stone rails frame the upper portion of the page. No object intersections or bridge rails cutting through bodies. The dragon’s body is continuous with clean occlusion where it overlaps clouds. Characters and dragon have natural child and animal proportions with clear, expressive but restrained facial expressions in a classic children’s storybook style (not chibi). The scene has clear foreground, midground, and background separation using outlines only, with reduced empty space and a dynamic, engaging composition suitable for coloring.

Use the attached character sheet reference images as the canonical identity and style.
